question: What percentage (0-100) of customers with at least one payment paid with a credit card at least once, regardless of order status?
sql:
WITH cust_pay AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id, p.payment_type
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
),
all_cust AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_unique_id
    FROM cust_pay
),
credit_cust AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_unique_id
    FROM cust_pay
    WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(cc.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(ac.customer_unique_id) AS credit_card_payment_percentage
FROM all_cust ac
LEFT JOIN credit_cust cc ON ac.customer_unique_id = cc.customer_unique_id
plan: • Identify customers via customers.customer_unique_id linked to orders.customer_id. • Join orders to payments on order_id to get each customer's payment records. • Determine the set of customers who have at least one payment record. • Determine the subset of those customers who have at least one payment where payment_type = 'credit_card'. • Compute the percentage as 100 * (count of credit‑card customers) / (count of all customers with payments).
